course_outline_concepts: Policy-gradient theorem — log-prob trick, score-function estimator
REINFORCE with and without baselines; variance reduction intuition
Actor-critic: bootstrapping trades bias for variance
Why LM-RL is special: discrete actions, deterministic dynamics, per-token credit assignment
Entropy term — regulariser vs bandaid for bad exploration

sources.what_to_extract: Williams 1992 REINFORCE derivation; ∇J(θ) = E[∇log π(a|s) · R]; causal per-step form with return-to-go G_t; baseline invariance proof (E_a[∇log π · b(s)] = 0); per-sequence LLM form; variance scaling with sequence length.
Monotonic-improvement bound η(π_new) ≥ L_π_old(π_new) − C·D_KL^max; importance-sampled surrogate L_π_old(π) = E[(π/π_old)·A]; KL trust-region; natural-gradient motivation; γ=0.99, GAE λ=0.95.

Combined actor-critic objective L^CLIP+VF+S = L^CLIP − c1·L^VF + c2·S; GAE δ_t and Â_t = Σ(γλ)^k δ_{t+k}; entropy bonus c2=0.01; token-level vs sequence-level in LLM RL; KL-to-reward vs entropy-bonus regularization.

LLM-RL is deterministic transitions + full-trajectory rewards; value head / GAE / clip / K>1 epochs are unnecessary for LLMs; RLOO estimator with leave-one-out baseline b_i = (1/(k−1)) Σ_{j≠i} R(y_j, x); unbiased, low variance; KL as per-token shaped reward R̃ = R − β·KL.

Global (batch) advantage normalization Â_t = (G_t − mean_B(G)) / std_B(G); per-token KL as shaped reward; token-level k1 KL estimator log π_θ_old − log π_ref; comparison table across PPO / RLOO / GRPO / REINFORCE++.

Three-stage RLHF pipeline framing; KL-regularized policy gradient; per-token reward r_total = r(x,y)·1[y=EOS] − β·log(π/π_ref); reward whitening; entropy bonus often dropped in RLHF because KL already regularizes; γ=1.0, GAE λ=0.95 RLHF defaults.

Algorithm-to-reward-signal framing (PPO-RLHF, DPO, GRPO, RLVR); algorithm family is less decisive than reward-signal source; base-model RL post-R1 lineage; length-normalization artifact in GRPO; RL-for-LLMs converging on small algorithmic template.

Implementation tricks that dominate reproducibility: orthogonal init, LR annealing, reward whitening, value-loss clipping, advantage normalization, global grad clip 0.5–1.0, minibatch shuffle, entropy coef schedule; RLHF specializations.

Max-ent objective J(π) = Σ_t E[r_t + α·H(π(·|s_t))]; optimal policy π*(a|s) ∝ exp(Q(s,a)/α); soft Bellman V(s) = α·log ∫ exp(Q/α); auto-α tuning against target entropy H̄; why fixed entropy bonus is inferior to target-entropy schedule.
